tools.description: Kubernetes package manager with templating, versioning, and application lifecycle management
tools.usage:
helm upgrade --install myapp ./chart --wait --timeout=300s # Deploy with rollback safety
helm rollback myapp 1 --wait # Instant rollback to previous version
helm template . --values prod.yaml > rendered.yaml # Dry-run template rendering
helm diff upgrade myapp ./chart --values prod.yaml # Preview changes
